links.reason: Kural 542's குடி live கோல் நோக்கி, looking to the sceptre in dependence; verse 14 makes கோல்வழி வாழ்தல் the land's குணம, a virtue of following set beside the wife's கொண்டான் வழியொழுகல் and the soldier's not leaving the முனை. Item 5 carries the link, and the shift from the people's dependence to their duty is real; 'the king's duty' is an inference from the couplet's chapter rather than its words.

Elathi 61 counts six ஊனம் of the உயிர் (ஆர்வம், செற்றம், கதம், ஒர்வம், உலோபம், மானம்) against the Kural's காமம் வெகுளி மயக்கம்; the longer list adds no condition to 360, so qualifies does not fit. The teaches' shift 'from error of mind to faults of self-regard' fails: செற்றம் and ஒர்வம் are not self-regard, and ஆர்வம், கதம் are as mental as the Kural's triad. Naming item 3 (கதம்) does not carry a whole-list comparison.
links.text_issue: ஒர்வமே in line 2 is an unknown form; the reading ஓர்வம் is a guess.

links.reason: Both returning men, speaking for the charioteer, send the heart ahead to her shoulders: Kar 19 தோடுணையா (தோள் துணையா) வேண்டி நெடுவிடைச் சென்றதென் நெஞ்சு, Akam 9 மென்தோள் பெறநசைஇச் சென்றவென் நெஞ்சே, with எம்மினும் விரைந்து making the outrunning explicit. The shared figure is distinctive, and the contrast (the Akam heart reaches the house and her braid, the venba's only sets out) is true.
links.text_issue: Kar 19's colophon reads தலைமகள் பாகற்குச் சொல்லியது; the speaker is the returning man, so தலைமகன் is meant.

links.reason: The match is real: சோற்றரவம் சொல்லியுண்பான் answers காக்கை கரைந்துண்ணும், and the fruit (கேடில் அரசனாய்) answers ஆக்கமும். But the teaches' claim that the practice came 'before it was a figure' is a chronology neither verse supports, and it misses the closer tie of கிளைஓம்பின் to the couplet's kin-sharing. list_adds is true: the three அரவம் (வேற்று-, சோற்று-, மாற்று-) set the call he makes against the noises he shuns.

Both name bad wives, and the contrast holds in the main: Naladiyar 363's faults lie in the house (எதிர்நிற்பாள், அட்டில் புகாதாள், உண்டி யுதவாதாள்), while the verse's பிறர் இல்சேறல் and பிறர்கருமம் ஆராய்தல் face outward. But 'all lie outside' overstates: கள்ளுண்டல் is not an outside act, and the fifth item rests on a doubtful line. The norm is reported as the period's, not endorsed.
links.text_issue: Lines 3-4 கிளைமைத் துறமது are doubtful, and காணில் in line 1 is hard to place.

links.reason: The contrast is real: முத்தேர் முறுவலார் சொல் இனிது in 1, and in 37 knowing women of தடமென் பணைத்தோள் as விடம் is sweet. But neither verse limits the other, so qualifies does not fit, and as the teaches itself says the two speak to different audiences, so this is not a tension either. Verse 1's list (learning, the assembly, company of superiors) is not marked as householder counsel, so that half of the teaches is inferred.
links.text_issue: Line 2 of verse 1, நற்சலையில், is not a known word; நற்சவையில் is likely.

links.reason: Kural 586 says only that a spy goes in துறந்தார் படிவம், the guise of renunciants; it says nothing about wanderers, and nothing about whether travellers should be trusted. Puram 47's பிறர்க்குத் தீது அறிந்தன்றோ? இன்றே defends the bard's பரிசில் வாழ்க்கை. No claim of the one is incompatible with the other, and the 'tension' rests on a suspicion that neither text states.

The pair is exact: Kural 247 matches பொருள் with this world and அருள் with that one, and the verse gives பொருளினால் ஆகும் போகம், நெகிழ்ந்த அருளினால் ஆகும் அறம். நெகிழ்ந்த adds the melting of the heart, which the couplet lacks. Item 5 carries the grace half, and the wealth half lies in item 4.

The comparison is apt: 360's காமம் வெகுளி மயக்கம் against the verse's பற்று, அவா and பொய்த்துரை, whose destruction ends பிறப்பு. Counting a fault of speech among the roots is a real difference. But the verse adds no condition or limit to the couplet; it gives a different list of roots, which is develops.
links.text_issue: Line 3 பகையிருளும் has a witness reading புகையிருளும்.

links.reason: Kural 443 calls winning the great as one's own அரியவற்றுள் அரிது. The verse's item 4, பெரிய பெரியரான் எய்தப் படும், gives the reason, and item 3's அரிய அரியவற்றாற் echoes the couplet's own wording. Grounding the moral rule in the physical cases இரும்பின் இரும்பிடை போழ்ப and the water rinse is what the list adds.

Both concern spreading faults (குறளை, தூற்றும்) as a mark of friendship. The teaches only redescribes the verse's குறளையுள் நட்பளவு தோன்றும் and shows nothing that the pair adds to either. The verse is itself uncertain (பிரமாணம், வாய்மை யடையார்), so a thin connection rests on a shaky line.
links.text_issue: வாய்மை யடையார் could be negative, which would reverse the predicate.

links.reason: Kural 386 says the accessible, gentle-spoken king's நிலம் is spoken of above others (மீக்கூறும்); the verse says நாட்டாக்கம் is people saying நல்லன் இவ் வேந்து. The pair moves from the conduct that earns praise to the praise as the land's prosperity, and item 3 carries it. Setting this among மனைக்காக்கம் and வினைக்காக்கம் is what the list does.

The contrast is real: Kural 263's மறந்தார்கொல் ... தவம் implies that provisioning renunciants is no substitute for தவம், while Elathi 70 rewards gifts to அருந்தவர் with rule of வையமும் வானும். But 'the giver gains what the ascetic seeks' stretches it: the verse's reward is rule (ஆளும்) over both worlds, not release. The pair is closer to a qualification of the couplet than a development of it.

Verse 28's four faults are வாயின (of the mouth), verse 29's three are மெய்யளவாக (of the body), and verse 27 (checked in the Tamil) gives three உள்ளத்த (of the mind), so the ten are complete. The claim that the count runs across verses is true and specific to the pair.

Both tie heaven to fame. Puram 27 gives it as hearsay (எய்துப என்ப ... எனக் கேட்பல்) to புலவர் பாடும் புகழுடையோர், and the saying states புகழ்வெய்யோர்க்குப் புத்தேள்நாடு எளிது flatly. The hedge dropping and the condition moving from the praised to the one who desires fame are both in the words. Puram 27's thurai is itself முதுமொழிக் காஞ்சி. 'Hardening' is a historical gloss, but a mild one.

Both are the தோழி's assurance during parting, a stock situation. The 'two fears' frame does not hold for 237: the girl's grief there is the sleepless spring nights, not a fear that pleasure will hold him, and Uranthai appears only as a hypothetical (எய்தினும் ... தவிரலர்). The connection is the shared thurai, and the 'set repertoire' point says no more than that.

Kural 610's அடியளந்தான் தாஅயது and the invocation's அடியினால் முக்காற் கடந்தான் முழுநிலம் share the stride, and item 2 carries it. The couplet's மடியிலா also chimes with the invocation's மடியகத்து. The two uses differ in a way worth reading: a measure of the king's reach in the one, a deed among four in the other.

Both praise கற்பு / கற்ப as the way out of darkness: மம்மர் இருள்தீர்ந்த கண் in 22, and in 28 மடம் அஃகும் leading to கோளுணரும் and the higher world. The point that 28 makes the sight the first link of a chain is true, but this is one book praising learning twice, close to a shared virtue word.

The verse ends on the couplet's own words, பெய்எனப் பெய்யும் மழை, and gives the power to three: the wife who is கொண்டான் குறிப்பறிவான், the தவசி and the அரசன். Sharing it out from the wife alone to the three stations is true and specific, and item 1 carries the link. The norm is reported as the text's.
links.text_issue: Line 1 குறிப்பறிவான் is masculine for the wife; line 3 repaired from சொய்வான்.

links.reason: Both condemn rule without முறை (முறையின்றி யாளும் அரசு; முறைசெய்யா மன்னவன்), a shared word. The teaches' claim that the verse looks at the subjects' suffering is not in the Tamil: இன்னா names no sufferer, and the unfenced cane is a picture of futile guarding, not of subjects. So the list does not judge rule 'by the protection it fails to give'.
links.text_issue: Line 2 உறைசேர் has variants புரைசேர் and சோர்.

links.reason: Sirupanchamoolam 15 sets பிழைத்தல் பொறுத்தல் பெருமை against இழைத்த தீங்கு எண்ணியிருத்தல் சிறுமை, and Thirikadugam 21 has செருவாய்ப்பச் செய்தவை நாடாச் சிறப்புடைமை. The pair is the same act seen from both sides (சிறப்பு / சிறுமை), and it gives real help in reading the doubtful Thirikadugam line as forgiveness. The agreement teaches something specific.

On the reading that குலம் is birth rank, கலத்தல் குலமில் வழி இன்னா makes rank count, which pulls against பிறப்பொக்கும். But 972 speaks of சிறப்பு from deeds, not of whom to marry, and the verse's own first item, குலத்துப் பிறந்தவன் கல்லாமை, makes birth without learning a pain, which sides with the Kural. list_adds' 'one order of standing' overstates a list that also counts a seed that fails to sprout.

Kural 134 says a பார்ப்பான்'s birth is lost when ஒழுக்கம் fails; the verse's வேட்பவன் பார்ப்பான் ties the term to the rite. Two different tests for the same status is a true and specific contrast, the verse adds a condition, and both are treated as norms the texts state. The list naming each person by one mark (கற்புடைமை, கேட்பவன், சிந்தை, தந்தை) is accurate.

Both give the tripura deed in the same parts: Paripadal's நாகம் நாணா, மலை வில்லாக, மூவகை ஆர் எயில் ஓர் அழல்-அம்பின் and Puram 55's மலைப் பெருவில் பாம்புஞாண் ... ஒரு கணை ... மூவெயில். Both also turn to the forehead eye (நெற்றி இமையா நாட்டத்து; பிறை நுதல் விளங்கும் ஒருகண்). That the formula serves both counsel to a Pandya and Murugan's birth is accurate.
links.text_issue: Paripadal lines 36-41 are compressed and their sense uncertain.

links.reason: The verbal tie is real (தொழீஇ அடவுண்ணார; தொழுதுண்டு), but தொழீஇ அட may instead mean food cooked by one made to bow, a reading on which the link fails. The teaches' contrast is also false: Kural 1033 is already about self-respect (தொழுது, பின்செல்பவர்), not only economics. The list's setting beside தோழரில் துஞ்சார் and வௌவார் is accurately described.

Kural 229 ranks தமியர் உணல் below begging; the saying widens it to தானோர் இன்புறல் and measures it by தனிமை. That widens the couplet rather than adding a condition to it, so the type is develops. The contrast of shame and isolation holds, and the Tamil of saying 38 (அறிவிலி துணைப்பாடு தனிமையின் துவ்வாது) confirms the list_adds claim.

The tie is real: நன்றின்பால் உய்த்து echoes the Kural's ஆறுய்த்து. But பெருக்குக நட்டாரை most naturally means to make one's friends prosper by leading them to the good, not to multiply them, and the marker's own nuance says so; the teaches' 'how one gains more of them' rests on the weaker reading. The list's two increases against two decreases is accurate.

The couplet calls the hoarder செத்தான், and the verse says பொருளினைத் துவ்வான் புதைத்துவைப்பான் is பிறந்தும் பிறந்திலாதார். Dead at the end and never born at the start is a true and pointed result of the pair. Setting the hoarder with the graceless heart and the hurtful tongue is accurately described.

Thirikadugam's ஐங்குரவர் ஆணை மறுத்தல் gets its five from Acharakkovai 16 (அரசன் உவாத்தியான் தாய்தந்தை தம்முன், நிகரில் குரவர்), and the positive rule (தேவரைப் போலத் தொழுக) is set against the breach. Ranking that breach with பொய்வழக்கு in friendship and forsaking the கற்புடையாள் is in the verse.

Kural 310 sets சினத்தைத் துறந்தார் equal to துறந்தார். The verse's வெகுளி நுணுக்கும் விறல் thins anger rather than renouncing it, and sets it among the தொல்லறிவாளர் தொழில் with conduct toward women and பாத்துண்ணல். The household setting is real, but 'householder's strength' is the marker's domain, not the verse's, and the sharper point (thinning against renouncing) is left out.
links.text_issue: Line 2's மகளிர்கட்கு ஒத்த லொழுக்கம் is ambiguous.

links.reason: Innaa 30's ஒடுங்கி அரவுறையும் இல் and Nanmanikkadigai 56's உள்கரந்து பாம்புறையும் புற்று share the hidden-snake dwelling, and item 4 carries it. Turning the bodily danger into the man who will not say உற்றது is a real gain from the pair.
links.text_issue: The grouping of lines 1-2 (கண்ணோடார்) is unclear.

links.reason: Kural 784 makes இடித்தல், rebuke, the purpose of friendship; the verse's யாழொக்கும் நட்டார் கழறும்சொல் tells how the rebuke is to be heard. That pairs the friend's duty with the hearer's response, and item 3 carries the link. The list's likenesses of good and bad company are accurately described.

Both make love the condition of kinship: Kural 522's விருப்பறாச் சுற்றம், the saying's ஈரம் இல்லாதது கிளைநட்பு அன்று. The teaches' contrast of gains against the name of kin is true but thin, since the couplet's condition is also inward. The run of definitions in sayings 41-46 (தாரம், வாழ்க்கை, நட்டோன், கல்வி) confirms the list_adds claim.
links.text_issue: ஈரலில் for ஈரமில் is an unusual spelling.

links.reason: Both weigh river rites: the verse's கங்கைக் கரைப்பூசை போற்றக் கடை ranks Ganga worship last, and the Siddhar's நீராடப்போய் என்ன makes bathing useless without knowing மாற்றிப் பிறக்க வகை. 'Dismisses outright' overstates the Siddhar, whose point is that the rite is useless without the knowing, not that it is false. The verse's ranks (தலை, உயர், கடை) are also uncertain.
links.text_issue: உரைப்பூசல் கோறல் may mean quarrels and killing.

links.reason: Both speak of giving by those without means: இடும்பை யுடையார் கொடை in the verse, இடனில் பருவத்தும் ஒப்புரவிற்கு ஒல்கார் in the Kural. But இன்னா names a pain, not a prohibition: a gift can be painful to give and still be given, so the conflict needs the 'to be avoided' reading, which the verse's list does not secure. list_adds fails on item 4: கொடும்பாடுடையார் do lack virtue, so 'not because he lacks virtue' is untrue of the list.

Naladiyar 347's base, dressed in wealth like a gold sandal, are known by their deeds; the quatrain's base, though பாசத்துள் இட்டு விளக்கினும், show their மாசு. Fortune and scouring both failing to change nature is a true gain from the pair, and the gem that keeps its சீர் though soiled sets up the reversal, as list_adds says.

Kural 720 gives the reason for silence before தங்கணத்தார் அல்லார் (nectar spilled in the yard); the verse's item 3 makes கொள்ளாருள் கொள்ளாத கூறாமை a mark of the good, kept even பாய்ந்தெழுந்து, under provocation. Setting it beside being called worthy and intimate by peers is accurate.

Kural 917's பிறநெஞ்சிற் பேணிப் புணர்பவர் and the verse's மனம்பிறிதாய்க் காரியத்திற் குன்றாக் கணிகை share the divided heart, and item 2 carries it. What the verse adds is that her business never fails, and the list sets her among three போற்றற்கு அரியார், the hard to keep, which is true of the list.

Both list the birth-room's needy: ஈன்றார், சூலார், குழவிகள் in Elathi, and ஈன்றெடுத்தல், சூல்புறஞ் செய்தல், குழவியை ஏன்றெடுத்தல் in Sirupanchamoolam, with item 3 (சூலார்) matching. Elathi adds feeding and cure (ஊண்ஈய்த்து உறுநோய் களைந்தார்) and a fruit (பெருஞ்செல்வம்) where Sirupanchamoolam appeals to முதுநூலார். The verses themselves do not say they are Jain works.

The mirror is exact and teaches holds: வேண்டாமை அன்ன விழுச்செல்வம் இல்லை against நசையில் பெரியதோர் நல்குரவு இல்லை moves both wealth and poverty into wanting. But list_adds invents a cause: saying 59 (இரத்தலின் ஊஉங்கு இளிவரவு இல்லை) stands in the same ten, with 58 between them, and nothing in the ten draws desire into begging as a sequence.

The phrase ஒண்பொருள் செய்வம் / செய்வல் is shared. But Thirikadugam's daring lies in இரந்துகொண்டு, making wealth by begging, not in the plan to make wealth, so 'both make it a hardship' misdescribes it. A shared phrase with different points is at best same_image.

Kural 99's எவன்கொலோ வன்சொல் is met by the verse's வெட்கென்றார் வெஞ்சொலால் இன்புறுவார், and the answer (harsh speech pleases the harsh, so the argument from sweetness will not reach them) is a fair reading. But the verse's lines 2-3 are obscure (தாழியா, தெற்றென்றார). The list_adds analogy, that words follow from nature 'as watches follow from naazhigai', is not what the first two gems say: they say great spans are made of small units.

verses.note: The small gifts run as a list without a count word. கூற்றோ(டு) and இத் துணையோ(டு) are taken as linking phrases rather than items, giving five.
The five are a woman's virtues, measured even against Lakshmi (பூந்திருவே யாயினும்).
Only three claims are found where four are expected: lines 3-4 make one statement, that what is done in one birth becomes an unfailing seed.
ஒத்தும் ஒழுக்கம் உடையவர் may point to ascetics, but the verse does not name them, so the domain is all.
அசனம் (food) in line 3 is given together with these six; it is read as the frame of the gift, not a seventh item.
கொல்லான் and கொலைபுரியான் are taken together as one item; counted apart they would give seven.
The fruit is kingship (அரசாண்டு), but the counsel is for anyone. வழுக்கான் might go with மனைபொருள் வௌவான் as one item, which would give five.
Only three things are named where five or six are expected; the verse closes on a disclaimer of knowledge (அறியலம்) rather than a fourth item.
இழியினர் (the low) is not clearly a birth term and states no rule, so no norm is given. Line 2's தவமல்லா is obscure.
Five definitions are found where four are expected: line 1 holds two (வேளாளன், பார்ப்பான்). These define varna and the wife, so caste and gender norms are given.
Lines 2-3 are corrupt (உயை஡ளர், ஊண்ஈய்ந்தபர், மாக்கடால்), so the fifth item is unreadable.
The chain ends in the king's rise through his people's; the address to a woman (வார்சான்ற கூந்தல்) is only the frame.
Four acts of the farmer lead into the turn, in which the scripture-readers' plough is subtle; the turn is counted as the fifth item. The verse sets no birth rule, so no norm is given.
